description: Documentation source file for Playwright API, describing classes, properties, and usage examples for the Playwright module, including language bindings in JS, Java, Python, and C#.

classes.name: Playwright
classes.description: Main class providing access to browser types, device configurations, error classes, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: Playwright.create
methods.description: Initializes a new Playwright driver instance, establishing connections to browser engines.

methods.name: Playwright.close
methods.description: Terminates the Playwright instance and all associated browsers.

methods.name: Playwright.stop
methods.description: Terminates the Playwright instance in environments where it was created outside the context manager, such as in REPLs.
